product_context.problem_statement: Nguoi truong thanh thuong kho chuyen cac chi so suc khoe, can nang va muc van dong thanh lua chon bua an an toan, de hieu va phu hop voi muc tieu quan ly can nang.
target_users: Nguoi truong thanh tu 18 tuoi tro len tai Viet Nam co muc tieu duy tri hoac cai thien can nang nguy co thap
product_context.value_hypothesis: Neu goi y bua an duoc ca nhan hoa trong pham vi an toan va co the giai thich, nguoi dung se theo doi muc tieu dinh duong deu dan hon ma khong tang tu van nguy hiem.
in_scope: Thu thap du lieu do nguoi dung tu khai co su dong y
Tinh BMI va phan nhom muc van dong
Goi y bua an va thoi quen van dong muc do thap
Canh bao va chuyen tu van vien khi co red flag
non_goals: Chan doan, dieu tri hoac ke don
Thay the bac si hay chuyen gia dinh duong
Tao thuc don dieu tri cho benh man tinh, thai ky hoac roi loan an uong
Khuyen nghi giam can cap toc hay luong nang luong cuc thap
product_context.user_journey_moment: Sau khi nguoi dung nhap muc tieu, can nang, chieu cao, muc van dong va thong tin suc khoe tu khai, truoc khi chon bua an trong ngay.
product_context.fallback_experience: Neu du lieu thieu, mau thuan hoac co red flag, ung dung khong tao goi y ca nhan hoa; hien thong bao an toan, tai lieu chung da duoc duyet va kenh dat lich voi chuyen gia dinh duong.

system_profile.purpose: Ho tro nguoi dung nguy co thap lap ke hoach an uong va van dong co the thuc hien duoc, dua tren thong tin tu khai va rang buoc an toan da duoc phe duyet.
user_groups: Chuyen gia dinh duong duyet noi dung
Nhan vien ho tro va xu ly su co
system_profile.decision_impact: Khuyen nghi co the anh huong hanh vi an uong va can nang; nguoi dung van tu quyet dinh va cac truong hop nguy co cao phai duoc chuyen nguoi co chuyen mon.
data_types: Tuoi va gioi tinh tu khai
Chieu cao, can nang va muc tieu
Di ung, che do an va tinh trang suc khoe tu khai
Nhat ky tuong tac va su dong y
system_profile.deployment_context: Ung dung web/mobile pilot tai Viet Nam; chi mo cho nguoi dung da dong y, qua sang loc tuoi va red-flag; khong tich hop ho so benh an dien tu trong pilot.

system_boundary.model: Mo hinh ngon ngu tao sinh bi rang buoc boi luat an toan va kho noi dung dinh duong da duyet.
system_boundary.application: Form nhap lieu, bo loc red-flag, bo tao goi y, giao dien giai thich, log va kenh bao cao su co.
people: Chuyen gia dinh duong dang ky hanh nghe
Nhan vien ho tro nguoi dung
vendors: Nha cung cap mo hinh AI theo hop dong xu ly du lieu
Nha cung cap cloud duoc phe duyet
upstream_inputs: Du lieu do nguoi dung tu khai
Co so du lieu dinh duong duoc chuyen gia duyet
downstream_decisions: Nguoi dung lua chon bua an
He thong tu choi ca nhan hoa va chuyen chuyen gia
Doi van hanh pause hoac rollback tinh nang

industry_risk_snapshot.rationale: Khuyen nghi dinh duong co the lam nguoi dung thay doi hanh vi lien quan den suc khoe; sai sot voi benh nen, di ung hoac roi loan an uong co the gay hai dang ke va mot phan hau qua kho dao nguoc. He thong xu ly du lieu suc khoe va can nang nhay cam. Pilot gioi han quy mo nhung can human oversight cho noi dung, red-flag, incident va truong hop phuc tap. WHO ghi nhan rui ro ve an toan benh nhan, thien lech va su dung du lieu suc khoe khong dao duc trong AI y te (SRC-01); nghien cuu dinh duong cho thay do chinh xac cua chatbot giam trong tinh huong benh ly chong lap (SRC-02). Day la triage san pham, khong phai phan loai phap ly.

vietnam.rationale: San pham xu ly thong tin suc khoe va dua ra khuyen nghi ca nhan hoa. Pham vi pilot khong chan doan hay dieu tri, nhung can legal/privacy review de xac dinh nghia vu dong y, xu ly du lieu ca nhan nhay cam, minh bach AI va pham vi quy dinh y te ap dung.

eu.rationale: Neu mo rong sang EU, phan loai phu thuoc intended purpose, claims va cach tich hop vao quy trinh cham soc. Trang chinh thuc EU AI Act nen duoc legal counsel ap dung cung GDPR va quy dinh thiet bi y te truoc khi cung cap tai thi truong nay.

legal_classification.other_markets: Chua danh gia; khong cung cap ngoai Viet Nam trong pilot.

product_metrics.success_kpi: Ty le nguoi dung nguy co thap hoan tat ke hoach bua an hang tuan la it nhat 45% sau 8 tuan, chi tinh nguoi da dong y theo doi.
product_metrics.risk_kri: Ty le phien tu van bi danh dau harmful-advice, red-flag miss hoac privacy incident phai duoi 0.5% moi tuan; moi su co phai duoc triage trong 24 gio.
product_metrics.guardrail_metric: Khong co goi y ca nhan hoa duoc gui khi red-flag chua ro, va 100% mau red-flag trong kiem thu pre-release phai bi escalation dung.
product_metrics.review_cadence: Hoi dong Product-Risk hop hang tuan trong pilot; re-review ngay khi co su co muc nghiem trong, cap nhat model, thay doi data/vendor, hoac KRI vuot nguong.

release_decision.independent_reviewer: Data Protection Officer va chuyen gia dinh duong doc lap
release_blockers: GAP-01: Chua co bang chung kiem thu red-flag va escalation dat 100%
GAP-02: Chua co clinical sign-off cho kho noi dung va rang buoc an toan
GAP-03: Chua hoan thanh danh gia privacy, consent va xu ly su co
release_conditions: Chi mo pilot cho nguoi lon nguy co thap sau khi GAP-01, GAP-02 va GAP-03 done
Khong tu van cho thai ky, benh nen, di ung nghiem trong hoac dau hieu roi loan an uong; phai escalation
Co nut bao cao, kill switch va quy trinh review incident trong 24 gio
release_decision.next_review_trigger: Truoc ngay 2026-10-15 hoac ngay lap tuc khi co harmful advice, missed red flag, privacy incident, thay doi model/vendor hay mo rong scope.
release_decision.residual_risk_rationale: Ngay ca khi co guardrail, nguoi dung co the nhap sai du lieu hoac hieu sai goi y. Rủi ro chi duoc chap nhan trong pilot gioi han cho nguoi nguy co thap, voi tu choi/escalation, clinical review, giam sat lien tuc va quyen pause ngay lap tuc.
